scope.market_definition: The Flower Pots and Planters Market encompasses the production, distribution, and sale of various types of pots and planters used for gardening and landscaping. Key participants include manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, and retailers operating globally in both indoor and outdoor segments.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the distribution of flower pots and planters from manufacturers to various sales channels.

## Cooee Design

Cooee is a contemporary design brand with its roots in the heart of Sweden’s Småland. The brand’s
timeless products are easily mixed and matched since they all have a sophisticated, minimalistic
Scandinavian look and come in muted colours that fit perfectly with each other.

## News-Woody

The success continues! Together with designer Eddie Gustafsson, we are expanding the Woody
collection with more furniture and interior details made from FSC®-certified wood – now also
available in the new **Dark Oak finish**.

[Explore Woody][35]

## Form & Function

Woody is a collection created in collaboration with designer Eddie Gustafsson. Natural materials and
timeless forms meet in mirrors, hooks, coffee tables, and a firewood basket – all crafted from
FSC-certified wood. A series that unites function and beauty, with a simple elegance made to last
for generations.

[Explore Woody][36]

## Soft Waves

The Twist series is a continuation of the iconic Ball Vase, with a soft and playful expression. The
sculptural wave-like shapes bring a lively impression to the home – whether displayed on their own
or in a group. The collection includes the Twist Ball Vase in two sizes as well as the Twist Bulb
Vase – perfect for seasonal flowers, branches, or decorative arrangements. Made of ceramic with a
silky matte finish that highlights the gentle forms.

## Cooee Design

Cooee is a contemporary design brand with its roots in the heart of Sweden’s Småland. The brand’s
timeless products are easily mixed and matched since they all have a sophisticated, minimalistic
Scandinavian look and come in muted colours that fit perfectly with each other.

[Our products][34]

## News-Woody

The success continues! Together with designer Eddie Gustafsson, we are expanding the Woody
collection with more furniture and interior details made from FSC®-certified wood – now also
available in the new **Dark Oak finish**.

[Explore Woody][35]

## Form & Function

Woody is a collection created in collaboration with designer Eddie Gustafsson. Natural materials and
timeless forms meet in mirrors, hooks, coffee tables, and a firewood basket – all crafted from
FSC-certified wood. A series that unites function and beauty, with a simple elegance made to last
for generations.

[Explore Woody][36]

## Soft Waves

The Twist series is a continuation of the iconic Ball Vase, with a soft and playful expression. The
sculptural wave-like shapes bring a lively impression to the home – whether displayed on their own
or in a group. The collection includes the Twist Ball Vase in two sizes as well as the Twist Bulb
Vase – perfect for seasonal flowers, branches, or decorative arrangements. Made of ceramic with a
silky matte finish that highlights the gentle forms.

[Explore Twist][37]

## Where Traditional Pottery Meets Modern Manufacturing

DNF Ceramics stands as one of the most respected ceramic manufacturers in India, known for blending
traditional pottery with modern production techniques. From large **[terracotta planters][14]**,
clay planters, and earthen planters to vases, tall ceramic pots, and decor items, our factory serves
national and international wholesale buyers with consistent quality, creative designs, and durable
craftsmanship. Whether you’re sourcing for retail, hospitality, or gifting, trust DNF Ceramics to
deliver excellence every time, at scale.

### DNF Ceramics — India's Leading Artisanal Ceramic Manufacturer Since 1976

### DNF Ceramics — Khurja's finest ceramic manufacturers since 1976.

#### Handcrafted by artisans, built for scale. From our kiln to your space — direct, honest,
#### beautiful

Established in 1976, **DNF Ceramics** is a proud family-owned business and one of the most trusted
**ceramic manufacturers in India, based in Khurja**. With decades of expertise, we craft premium
ceramic products designed for durability and elegance. Today, we serve a wide range of industries, 
including restaurants, hotels, cafés, catering businesses, and home décor brands, delivering quality
ceramic solutions that blend traditional craftsmanship with modern requirements.

With decades of experience in ceramic manufacturing, we combine traditional artisanal craftsmanship
with modern production techniques to create durable, aesthetic, and commercially viable ceramic
products. Our product range includes indoor ceramic pots, outdoor ceramic planters, extra large
planters, decorative ceramic pots, and custom-designed ceramic planters suitable for international
markets.

### About the gardeners

## Plant-loving locals, ready when you are.


**Gig-based.** Get garden care on your schedule by coordinating directly with the gardeners. Easily
book them online through our app.

**Affordable.** Gardeners set their rates at less than you'd pay a landscaping company. No
commitment, but you can book them repeatedly if you’d like!

**Nature-centered. **Your yard is an opportunity to improve soil health, increase biodiversity, and
create habitat. Our gardeners can help by getting more of the right plants in the ground.

### Services

## Nature-first care for any type of garden.

###### Weeding and invasives removal

Hire someone who knows their plants to nurture the species you want by removing the ones you don't.

###### Planting

From installing plugs or containerized plants to the various methods of seeding, our gardeners try
to limit disturbance and preserve the integrity of the existing landscape.

###### Design and plant lists

Get help designing your food, flower, pollinator, container, or decorative garden, all the way
through plant selection and curation.

###### General maintenance

Gardeners can help with watering, pruning, deadheading, mulching, reseeding, and other types of
general garden maintenance on a one-time or recurring basis.

###### Special projects

Some of our gardeners can help with special projects, such as setting up rainwater, irrigation, or
compost systems; tree care; or lightweight hardscaping tasks.

### HOW IT WORKS

## Meet local gardeners who can help with your landscaping needs.

#### 1

###### Find a local gardener.

[Browse our directory][12] based on your location and the landscaping services you need.

#### 2

###### Book directly with them.

No accounts required. Simply send your project request to a gardener and they'll email or text you
to arrange a meeting.

#### 3

###### Pay and enjoy!

Pay the gardener once work is completed via Venmo, Paypal, Zelle, or cash.

### About us

## We're on a mission...

...to get more of the right plants in the ground. Doing so improves soil health and creates habitat
for all creatures, especially invertebrates who play important ecological functions as pollinators
and the base of the food chain but are increasingly threatened by our climate crisis. Ultimately,
through gardener training, we hope to increase the number of “plant people” capable of nurturing
Earth's ecosystems.

# Welcome to Growscape

### Rooted in legacy. Growing the future.

At Growscape, we bring together decades of expertise from the industry's most trusted names in
horticultural containers to lead the way forward. Combining the strength of legacy brands like The
HC Companies and Classic Home & Garden, we are united by one mission: to help growers, retailers,
and distributors succeed—sustainably and efficiently.

## Proven Leaders. Trusted Partners. Forward Thinkers.

[Customer-Driven Solutions]

## Customer-Driven Solutions

We don't just serve growers and retailers—we collaborate with them. From product ideation to
delivery, our team is committed to responsive, transparent service. Your success is our purpose, and
we go the extra mile to ensure you feel supported at every stage.

[Global Delivery]

## Reliable Delivery. Always On Time.

With expert logistics management, global manufacturing, and a vast distribution network

[Essential Watering Can]

## Design with Intention

We stay ahead of trends to bring our partners fresh, modern designs that align with consumer demand.
Whether it's a retail planter that draws attention or a production pot built for high-efficiency
growing, design and function are always in sync.

[Innovation That Gets Its Hands Dirty]

## Innovation That Gets Its Hands Dirty

Our entrepreneurial roots drive us to solve problems others won't touch. We develop bold, practical
innovations—from production-ready containers to sustainable solutions—because progress doesn't
happen by playing it safe.

[Sustainability]

## Sustainable by Design

## Your customers care. So do we.

Growscape sees sustainability as the key to long-term customer success. We offer a comprehensive
line of sustainable containers—crafted from post-consumer and post-industrial materials, bio-based
alternatives, and fiber solutions—all manufactured in facilities that prioritize closed-loop water
recycling and waste reduction.

From round and square fiber pots to hanging baskets, trays, and growing strips, our sustainable
product line helps you stand out—and do better for the planet.

[ Learn more about Sustainability ][17]

## The Right Container for Every Customer

Whether you're growing in a greenhouse, supplying a nursery, or stocking a retail shelf, we have the
container solutions you need.

## donice do domu i ogrodu

Firma **KAMA** to polski producent donic ogrodowych oraz donic do wnętrz.

W swojej ofercie mamy trzy marki produkowanych seryjnie donic: **KAMA flower,**** KAMA pure, KAMA
concrete** oraz **donice na wymiar **wykonywane na indywidualne zamówienia według projektów
Klientów.

Donice firmy **KAMA** stanowią wspaniały dodatek do wystroju mieszkań, domów, tarasów, ogrodów i
przestrzeni miejskiej. Doskonale ozdobią także najbardziej reprezentacyjne miejsca jak recepcje firm
czy hoteli, znacznie podnosząc ich wygląd i prestiż.

Bardzo duży wybór kształtów, wielkości i kolorów, a także możliwość wykonania praktycznie dowolnych
donic według projektów Klientów sprawia, że każdy znajdzie w naszej ofercie coś idealnego dla
siebie.

Serdecznie zapraszamy!

## donice KAMA flower

**KAMA flower** to donice klasy Premium produkowane z kompozytów w dziewięciu liniach wzorniczych i
wysokościach dochodzących do 125 cm. Przez wielu uważane za najładniejsze z dostępnych na rynku.
Doskonały wybór dla najbardziej luksusowych wnętrz i ogrodów.

## donice KAMA pure

**KAMA pure** to donice w kształtach prostopadłościanów i walców produkowane z kompozytów w czterech
liniach wzorniczych i wielu wielkościach. Bardzo przydatne do tworzenia kompozycji typu przegroda
wnętrza, barierka tarasu czy kwietnik wzdłuż ściany.

## donice KAMA concrete

**KAMA concrete** to donice polimerobetonowe dedykowane głównie do przestrzeni publicznych. Są one
niezwykle wytrzymałe i trwałe przez co doskonale sprawdzą się jako donice ogrodowe oraz elementy
małej architektury na ulicach i w parkach. Produkowane w kształtach prostopadłościanów w wielu
wielkościach.

## donice na wymiar

**donice na wymiar** to odpowiedź na nietypowe potrzeby Klientów. Kształt ani wielkość nie stanowią
dla nas barier nie do pokonania. Wytwarzamy donice według indywidualnych projektów. Stosujemy
różnorodne materiały, technologie i rozwiązania.

## w kilku zdaniach o nas

Firma **KAMA** istnieje od 1988 roku.

Działamy w paru branżach – produkujemy donice, biokominki oraz łodzie żaglowe, motorowe i rowery
wodne. Po więcej szczegółów zapraszamy do odwiedzenia naszej witryny – **[www.kama.net.pl][16]**

Wszystko co robimy staramy się wykonywać jak najlepiej. Pracujemy z pasją i zawsze dążymy do
perfekcji. Z racji wykształcenia technicznego osób zarządzających firmą oraz pracowników, a także
długoletniego doświadczenia możemy powiedzieć, że znamy się na naszej pracy.

meters plant, located in Langxi industrial park, the junction of Anhui, Zhejiang and Jiangsu
province, enjoying convenient access to major transportation network. Our factory integrate
designing, researching, marketing and application of wood plastic composite material with
production.

customers from Europe, North American, South America, Africa, Middle East and Asian.

## Professional Custom Pottery Manufacturer

Founded in 1989, SANTAI Ceramics has been a leading supplier of exquisite ceramic products to
wholesalers and distributors worldwide for over 30 years. With three decades of accumulated
technology and experience, our expertise, combined with advanced production techniques, allows us to
craft ceramic works that honor traditional craftsmanship while seamlessly incorporating modern
design trends.
• Established in 1989 in Chaozhou - Ceramic Capital of China.
• **BSCI/SEDEX/CCIB/WCA/TARGET/LOWE'S certified.**
• **ISO9001/ISO14001/ISO45001 certified.**
• 3500㎡ Showroom & 80000㎡ Factory.
• Al SYSTEM by SANTAI controls entire production process and ensures reliability.
• Advanced equipment available (e.g. 3D printer waiting to serve you).
• Own design team since 1995 & working with European designers.
• Expert in Ancient-style Home/Garden Decor since 1994.
• Guangdong Top Brand & Famous Trademark.

Our one-stop customization service covers the entire process from design to delivery, providing full
support from the initial concept to detailed design, and using 3D design technology to help
customers visualize the final effect. In the production stage, we combine modern automated
production lines and traditional manual skills to ensure that each product has artistic value and
high quality. Through our SANTAI AI system, we provide customers with a comprehensive and convenient
customization experience.

# Modern Fiberglass Planters

We take pride in the art of creating exceptional planters that elevate the aesthetic of businesses,
retailers, and brands across the world. Our extensive collection of handcrafted indoor and outdoor
plant pots ranges from exquisite table-top planters to bold, attention-grabbing feature pieces. Each
of our planters is crafted using marine-grade fiberglass, ensuring that they not only exude elegance
but are also built to last. Trust us to provide you with planters that add a touch of sophistication
and durability to your space.

# Lightweight and Durable

The marine grade fiberglass in our products is a composite material that provides unrivaled
performance and durability in all weather conditions. Premium quality polyester resin is combined
with glass fibers to create a material that is as strong and reliable as traditional materials like
stone but much lighter in weight. The superior strength-to-weight ratio of fiberglass enables our
craftsmen to hand craft innovative designs of all shapes and sizes that can be installed, lifted and
carried with ease. Resistant to UV, frost and a range of other weather conditions, marine grade
fiberglass is ideal for use outdoors in any climate, from a sunny tower rooftop in Dubai to a New
York balcony in winter.

## Introducing the TAU Stone and Rough Cast Ranges

TAU’s new Stone and Rough Cast ranges celebrate the beauty and versatility of natural materials,
each offering a distinct take on timeless texture. The Stone range captures the quiet elegance of
carved stone with softly striated surfaces, subtle tonal depth, and a refined architectural feel,
bringing calm sophistication to both contemporary and traditional settings. In contrast, the Rough
Cast range embraces the raw, unrefined charm of weathered stone or hand-troweled earth, with organic
surface variations and handcrafted character that suit modern minimalism as well as rustic spaces.
Together, these finishes offer designers and architects a palette of understated luxury and grounded
elegance, enhancing interior and exterior projects alike.

## Suspended Liner Planters

Elevate your planting experience with our Suspended Liner Planters. Designed specifically for tall
containers, our innovative planters hold your grow pot securely at the top of the pot, eliminating
the need for fillers and platforms. Whether you choose to drop in a standard grow pot, replant
directly into the liner, or take advantage of our optional water indicator kit, our system offers
unmatched convenience and versatility. Perfect for interior plants, our Suspended Liner Planters
simplify the planting process, saving you time and effort while ensuring your plants look their
best.

“Living Beautiful” is a philosophy, a conscious choice to prioritize excellence in every facet of
life. It goes beyond mere aesthetics; it’s about the intrinsic value of things, their longevity, and
their ability to resonate with our sensibilities. TAU’s planters are a testament to this ethos.
Crafted with precision and care, each piece not only adds vibrancy to your spaces but also stands as
a beacon of unmatched craftsmanship. When you choose TAU, you’re not just selecting a planter,
you’re embracing a lifestyle that appreciates the finer nuances and quality that stands the test of
time.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Is there someone I can talk to?

Yes, at [**Ten Thousand Pots**][71], we want you to have the best pot-purchasing experience
possible. As a result, there are no middlemen, and we interact with both resale and wholesale
customers daily. We are open **SEVEN DAYS A WEEK **from 9 AM to 6 PM. If you call during business
hours, M-F, an actual person will pick up the phone. Any of our staff would be happy to answer your
questions or smooth out concerns.

If you have any questions, contact us at [**(512) 584-8889**][72],
or [**austin@tenthousandpots.com**][73], and we will be happy to help.

Can I order online?

Yes, we offer our complete catalog in our online store with pickup, delivery and nationwide shipping
options. Our available website inventory is the same as our cataloged yard inventory, but we are
shipping, unloading, and updating our inventory daily. Occasionally there are minor discrepancies,
but what you see available on our website is what we have to sell you in-store.

Do you deliver?

Yes, we offer white-glove delivery throughout Central Texas. Our initial fee is $40 for the trip
charge and $3 per mile. Our team members will expertly unload, unpack, and place your larger pots
for you, and our specialists can install your custom fountains. In the case that a second person is
needed to load and unload your order safely, a $20 fee will be applied.

Freight shipping options are available for deliveries outside the state and for all online orders.

Do you ship?

Yes, we use a robust shipping network to pass the savings on to you. For orders up to 60 pounds, we
use UPS ground shipping. For orders 61 pounds or over, we use a network of freight carriers and pack
your order on pallets. We use top-of-the-line, custom-packaging products to ensure your order
arrives in perfect condition. Our breakage rate is less than 1%, so you can be confident that your
order will get to you safely and securely. However, if your ceramics arrived damaged in any way,
send a photo of the damage to austin@tenthousandpots.com, and we will refund or exchange the item.

For more information, see our [**Packing and Shipping**][74]** **page. If you're in need of a cargo
container of [wholesale flower pots and planters][75], please check out our sister company TT
Pottery.

Why does the pot I ordered look different in-person?

All our products are one-of-a-kind and handmade, meaning no two pieces are exactly alike. We've
selected an image that best represents each product type for our website inventory. When you
purchase this item, our team will hand-select your unique item from our inventory. There may be
slight variations in color, finish, glaze, size, etc. If you have a specific request or want a photo
of what we've pulled before shipment, our team will happily ensure your order exceeds expectations.

Wilson Garden is a manufacturer of plastic nursery pots and seed trays for commercial growing. Our
products also include plastic grow pots, fabric grow bags, and other horticultural supplies. Plastic
Nursery Pots Bulk, Factory Price, Free Samples, Fast Delivery! We have more than 20 years
manufacturing experience, 35,000m2 workshop area. Serve nurseries, farms, greenhouses, and
distributors worldwide.

We ship [plastic plant pots][83] worldwide, such as USA, Canada, UK, Ireland, Australia, NZ,
Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Singapore, Indonesia, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, South Korea,
Japan, Vietnam, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Lebanon, Kuwait, Qatar, Bahrain, Jordan, Oman, Yemen, Mexico,
Trinidad, Jamaica, Barbados, Bahamas, Brazil, Chile, Ecuador, Peru, Colombia, Argentina, France,
Germany, Spain, Portugal, Belgium, Netherlands, Switzerland, Italy, Poland, Serbia, Greece, Romania,
Turkey, Cyprus, Egypt, Kenya, Uganda, Sudan, South Africa etc.

size. Strong rim. Smooth drainage.

# Welcome To BioExplorer^{®}

BioExplorer® is an independent biology resource founded in 1999, created to help readers explore
life science through clear articles, glossary guides, species profiles, and educational resources.
What began as a resource for researchers has grown into a trusted destination for writers, science
communicators, lifelong learners, nature enthusiasts, and curious readers interested in DNA, plants,
animals, ecosystems, evolution, and more.

[Read More][42]

## Exploring Life On Earth

[ [Animals] ][43]

#### [ Animals ][44]

Explore the Animal kingdom and different types of animals ([types of monkeys][45], [types of
apes][46], [types of crocodiles][47], [types of birds][48] & more) here.
[ [Bacteria] ][49]

#### [ Bacteria ][50]

Bacteria are tiny, single-celled organisms that drive ecosystems and human health, with many species
playing helpful roles while others lead to serious [diseases caused by bacteria][51].
[ [Biology Book Reviews] ][52]

#### [ Biology Book Reviews ][53]

Biology Book Reviews offers quick, insightful takes that help you pick the most fascinating reads in
science without wading through endless choices.
[ [Biological Organization] ][54]

#### [ Biological Organization ][55]

Biological organization explores the ten levels of life's structure, from atoms all the way up to
entire ecosystems, revealing how simple building blocks combine to create complex living systems.
[ [Dinosaurs] ][56]

#### [ Dinosaurs ][57]

Dinosaurs were the remarkable prehistoric giants that ruled Earth for over 160 million years,
leaving behind fossils that still fire our curiosity today.
[ [Biological Species Concept] ][58]

#### [ Biological Species Concept ][59]

The Biological Species Concept explains how organisms are grouped into species based on their
ability to interbreed and produce fertile offspring, helping scientists draw clearer lines in the
diversity of life.
[ [Fathers of Biology] ][60]

#### [ Fathers of Biology ][61]

The Fathers of Biology refers to the pioneering scientists whose groundbreaking work laid the
foundation for modern biological science as we know it.
[ [Biology Jobs] ][62]

#### [ Biology Jobs ][63]

Biology jobs span fields from research and healthcare to conservation and biotech, giving
science-minded individuals countless ways to turn curiosity about life into a career.
[ [Genetic Determinism] ][64]

#### [ Genetic Determinism ][65]

Genetic determinism is the idea that our genes heavily shape traits and behaviors, sparking debate
over how much of who we are is written in our DNA versus shaped by life experiences.
[ [Biology Tools and Calculators] ][66]

#### [ Biology Tools and Calculators ][67]

Free interactive biology calculators and analyzers covering genetics, molecular biology,
biochemistry, microbiology, ecology, and cell biology. Each tool runs in your browser with no
installation or signup required.
[ [Plants] ][68]

#### [ Plants ][69]

Discover the different **[types of plants][70]**, **[types of flowers][71]**, **[types of
trees][72]** and all plant-related topics here.
[ [Biological Magnification] ][73]

#### [ Biological Magnification ][74]

Biological magnification shows how toxins quietly climb the food chain, growing stronger at every
step until top predators carry the heaviest load.
[ [Biological Weathering] ][75]

#### [ Biological Weathering ][76]

Biological weathering shows how living organisms—from roots to microbes—quietly break down rocks and
reshape landscapes over time.

## Cooee Design

Cooee is a contemporary design brand with its roots in the heart of Sweden’s Småland. The brand’s
timeless products are easily mixed and matched since they all have a sophisticated, minimalistic
Scandinavian look and come in muted colours that fit perfectly with each other.

[Our products][34]

## News-Woody

The success continues! Together with designer Eddie Gustafsson, we are expanding the Woody
collection with more furniture and interior details made from FSC®-certified wood – now also
available in the new **Dark Oak finish**.

[Explore Woody][35]

## Form & Function

Woody is a collection created in collaboration with designer Eddie Gustafsson. Natural materials and
timeless forms meet in mirrors, hooks, coffee tables, and a firewood basket – all crafted from
FSC-certified wood. A series that unites function and beauty, with a simple elegance made to last
for generations.

[Explore Woody][36]

## Soft Waves

The Twist series is a continuation of the iconic Ball Vase, with a soft and playful expression. The
sculptural wave-like shapes bring a lively impression to the home – whether displayed on their own
or in a group. The collection includes the Twist Ball Vase in two sizes as well as the Twist Bulb
Vase – perfect for seasonal flowers, branches, or decorative arrangements. Made of ceramic with a
silky matte finish that highlights the gentle forms.

[Explore Twist][37]

# [Simple Present Tense Worksheets and Exercises (with Answers)][40]

The Present Simple Tense is one of the most basic and important verb tenses in English. We use it to
talk about habits, daily routines, general truths, and fixed schedules. If you want to speak English

### About the gardeners

## Plant-loving locals, ready when you are.


**Gig-based.** Get garden care on your schedule by coordinating directly with the gardeners. Easily
book them online through our app.

**Affordable.** Gardeners set their rates at less than you'd pay a landscaping company. No
commitment, but you can book them repeatedly if you’d like!

**Nature-centered. **Your yard is an opportunity to improve soil health, increase biodiversity, and
create habitat. Our gardeners can help by getting more of the right plants in the ground.

### Services

## Nature-first care for any type of garden.

###### Weeding and invasives removal

Hire someone who knows their plants to nurture the species you want by removing the ones you don't.

###### Planting

From installing plugs or containerized plants to the various methods of seeding, our gardeners try
to limit disturbance and preserve the integrity of the existing landscape.

###### Design and plant lists

Get help designing your food, flower, pollinator, container, or decorative garden, all the way
through plant selection and curation.

###### General maintenance

Gardeners can help with watering, pruning, deadheading, mulching, reseeding, and other types of
general garden maintenance on a one-time or recurring basis.

###### Special projects

Some of our gardeners can help with special projects, such as setting up rainwater, irrigation, or
compost systems; tree care; or lightweight hardscaping tasks.

### HOW IT WORKS

## Meet local gardeners who can help with your landscaping needs.

#### 1

###### Find a local gardener.

[Browse our directory][12] based on your location and the landscaping services you need.

#### 2

###### Book directly with them.

No accounts required. Simply send your project request to a gardener and they'll email or text you
to arrange a meeting.

#### 3

###### Pay and enjoy!

Pay the gardener once work is completed via Venmo, Paypal, Zelle, or cash.

### About us

## We're on a mission...

...to get more of the right plants in the ground. Doing so improves soil health and creates habitat
for all creatures, especially invertebrates who play important ecological functions as pollinators
and the base of the food chain but are increasingly threatened by our climate crisis. Ultimately,
through gardener training, we hope to increase the number of “plant people” capable of nurturing
Earth's ecosystems.

# Welcome to Growscape

### Rooted in legacy. Growing the future.

At Growscape, we bring together decades of expertise from the industry's most trusted names in
horticultural containers to lead the way forward. Combining the strength of legacy brands like The
HC Companies and Classic Home & Garden, we are united by one mission: to help growers, retailers,
and distributors succeed—sustainably and efficiently.

## Proven Leaders. Trusted Partners. Forward Thinkers.

[Customer-Driven Solutions]

## Customer-Driven Solutions

We don't just serve growers and retailers—we collaborate with them. From product ideation to
delivery, our team is committed to responsive, transparent service. Your success is our purpose, and
we go the extra mile to ensure you feel supported at every stage.

[Global Delivery]

## Reliable Delivery. Always On Time.

With expert logistics management, global manufacturing, and a vast distribution network

[Essential Watering Can]

## Design with Intention

We stay ahead of trends to bring our partners fresh, modern designs that align with consumer demand.
Whether it's a retail planter that draws attention or a production pot built for high-efficiency
growing, design and function are always in sync.

[Innovation That Gets Its Hands Dirty]

## Innovation That Gets Its Hands Dirty

Our entrepreneurial roots drive us to solve problems others won't touch. We develop bold, practical
innovations—from production-ready containers to sustainable solutions—because progress doesn't
happen by playing it safe.

[Sustainability]

## Sustainable by Design

## Your customers care. So do we.

Growscape sees sustainability as the key to long-term customer success. We offer a comprehensive
line of sustainable containers—crafted from post-consumer and post-industrial materials, bio-based
alternatives, and fiber solutions—all manufactured in facilities that prioritize closed-loop water
recycling and waste reduction.

From round and square fiber pots to hanging baskets, trays, and growing strips, our sustainable
product line helps you stand out—and do better for the planet.

[ Learn more about Sustainability ][17]

## The Right Container for Every Customer

Whether you're growing in a greenhouse, supplying a nursery, or stocking a retail shelf, we have the
container solutions you need.

# Pot manufacturer

pots, hanging pots, flower pots, plastic pots, home décor pots, and many more that can give shape to
your beautiful homes and outdoor gardens. These pots can be used for home décor, at hotels, building
lobbies, house balconies, gardens and at shopping malls. Our exclusive collection of planters is
available across India in cities like metropolitan cities.

## indoor planters

Our indoor pots, outdoor pots, hanging pots and roto moulded pots are available in trays, rounds,
rectangular shapes, and hanging or tall with a stand. We are manufacturers, wholesale traders and
suppliers of flower pots, hanging pots, indoor pots, balcony pots, outdoor pots, roto moulded pots
and FRP planters. The best nurseries in India widely recognize all our products. We have a large
clientele base consisting of plant lovers, nurseries, gardeners and industry specialists spread
across India. Apart from managing strict deliverable timelines for a massive quantity of pot
manufacturing, we also provide cost-effective production solutions for all quality pots to be
manufactured. Our production and manufacturing facility is empowered with the latest and best
technology required for manufacturing quality and sustainable pots. We have a colossal warehouse
capacity to systematically store a range of manufactured pots.

large plants in outdoor settings. Plant stores offer a wide selection of pot materials and sizes,
making it easy to find the perfect pot for your plants. With the right pot, you can create an
outdoor oasis that is both aesthetically pleasing and highly functional. Outdoor gardening is a
great way to spruce up your backyard and make it more inviting. Plant pots are one of the essential
items to help you do this. Whether you’re looking for small and stylish outdoor planters or large
wholesale plastic pots, there are various great options available for anyone’s budget and style.
With the right pot, you can create a stunning outdoor garden that will be the envy of all your
neighbours! Homeowners and gardeners alike realize that planting in indoor plant pots with stands is
an ideal way to cultivate and nurture their healthy plants. From the classic snake plant to a
selection of perfect nursery pots, there’s no shortage of options available for the home garden.
With suitable materials, design, and care, outdoor plant pots are essential to adding natural beauty
to any outdoor space. Shop plants from Harshdeep. Place flower pots in the balcony. Use it as a home
decor product.

## Manufacturers and suppliers of home decor pots

We work with interior designers and architects where our pots are used for home décor and
landscaping at bungalows. These plant pots are robust, durable and easy to move. All our pots are
premium quality and best in finishes as they are manufactured under stringent quality controls. We
are one of India’s leading manufacturers and suppliers of planters with a vast range of pots. We
have everything architects and interior designers are looking for regarding planters for their
residential and commercial projects.

## donice do domu i ogrodu

Firma **KAMA** to polski producent donic ogrodowych oraz donic do wnętrz.

W swojej ofercie mamy trzy marki produkowanych seryjnie donic: **KAMA flower,**** KAMA pure, KAMA
concrete** oraz **donice na wymiar **wykonywane na indywidualne zamówienia według projektów
Klientów.

Donice firmy **KAMA** stanowią wspaniały dodatek do wystroju mieszkań, domów, tarasów, ogrodów i
przestrzeni miejskiej. Doskonale ozdobią także najbardziej reprezentacyjne miejsca jak recepcje firm
czy hoteli, znacznie podnosząc ich wygląd i prestiż.

Bardzo duży wybór kształtów, wielkości i kolorów, a także możliwość wykonania praktycznie dowolnych
donic według projektów Klientów sprawia, że każdy znajdzie w naszej ofercie coś idealnego dla
siebie.

Serdecznie zapraszamy!

## donice KAMA flower

**KAMA flower** to donice klasy Premium produkowane z kompozytów w dziewięciu liniach wzorniczych i
wysokościach dochodzących do 125 cm. Przez wielu uważane za najładniejsze z dostępnych na rynku.
Doskonały wybór dla najbardziej luksusowych wnętrz i ogrodów.

## donice KAMA pure

**KAMA pure** to donice w kształtach prostopadłościanów i walców produkowane z kompozytów w czterech
liniach wzorniczych i wielu wielkościach. Bardzo przydatne do tworzenia kompozycji typu przegroda
wnętrza, barierka tarasu czy kwietnik wzdłuż ściany.

## donice KAMA concrete

**KAMA concrete** to donice polimerobetonowe dedykowane głównie do przestrzeni publicznych. Są one
niezwykle wytrzymałe i trwałe przez co doskonale sprawdzą się jako donice ogrodowe oraz elementy
małej architektury na ulicach i w parkach. Produkowane w kształtach prostopadłościanów w wielu
wielkościach.

## donice na wymiar

**donice na wymiar** to odpowiedź na nietypowe potrzeby Klientów. Kształt ani wielkość nie stanowią
dla nas barier nie do pokonania. Wytwarzamy donice według indywidualnych projektów. Stosujemy
różnorodne materiały, technologie i rozwiązania.

## w kilku zdaniach o nas

Firma **KAMA** istnieje od 1988 roku.

Działamy w paru branżach – produkujemy donice, biokominki oraz łodzie żaglowe, motorowe i rowery
wodne. Po więcej szczegółów zapraszamy do odwiedzenia naszej witryny – **[www.kama.net.pl][16]**

Wszystko co robimy staramy się wykonywać jak najlepiej. Pracujemy z pasją i zawsze dążymy do
perfekcji. Z racji wykształcenia technicznego osób zarządzających firmą oraz pracowników, a także
długoletniego doświadczenia możemy powiedzieć, że znamy się na naszej pracy.

wholesalers and distributors worldwide for over 30 years. With three decades of accumulated
technology and experience, our expertise, combined with advanced production techniques, allows us to
craft ceramic works that honor traditional craftsmanship while seamlessly incorporating modern
design trends.

• **BSCI/SEDEX/CCIB/WCA/TARGET/LOWE'S certified.**

• 3500㎡ Showroom & 80000㎡ Factory.
• Al SYSTEM by SANTAI controls entire production process and ensures reliability.
• Advanced equipment available (e.g. 3D printer waiting to serve you).
• Own design team since 1995 & working with European designers.
• Expert in Ancient-style Home/Garden Decor since 1994.
• Guangdong Top Brand & Famous Trademark.

support from the initial concept to detailed design, and using 3D design technology to help
customers visualize the final effect. In the production stage, we combine modern automated
production lines and traditional manual skills to ensure that each product has artistic value and
high quality. Through our SANTAI AI system, we provide customers with a comprehensive and convenient
customization experience.

# Modern Fiberglass Planters

We take pride in the art of creating exceptional planters that elevate the aesthetic of businesses,
retailers, and brands across the world. Our extensive collection of handcrafted indoor and outdoor
plant pots ranges from exquisite table-top planters to bold, attention-grabbing feature pieces. Each
of our planters is crafted using marine-grade fiberglass, ensuring that they not only exude elegance
but are also built to last. Trust us to provide you with planters that add a touch of sophistication
and durability to your space.

# Lightweight and Durable

The marine grade fiberglass in our products is a composite material that provides unrivaled
performance and durability in all weather conditions. Premium quality polyester resin is combined
with glass fibers to create a material that is as strong and reliable as traditional materials like
stone but much lighter in weight. The superior strength-to-weight ratio of fiberglass enables our
craftsmen to hand craft innovative designs of all shapes and sizes that can be installed, lifted and
carried with ease. Resistant to UV, frost and a range of other weather conditions, marine grade
fiberglass is ideal for use outdoors in any climate, from a sunny tower rooftop in Dubai to a New
York balcony in winter.

## Introducing the TAU Stone and Rough Cast Ranges

TAU’s new Stone and Rough Cast ranges celebrate the beauty and versatility of natural materials,
each offering a distinct take on timeless texture. The Stone range captures the quiet elegance of
carved stone with softly striated surfaces, subtle tonal depth, and a refined architectural feel,
bringing calm sophistication to both contemporary and traditional settings. In contrast, the Rough
Cast range embraces the raw, unrefined charm of weathered stone or hand-troweled earth, with organic
surface variations and handcrafted character that suit modern minimalism as well as rustic spaces.
Together, these finishes offer designers and architects a palette of understated luxury and grounded
elegance, enhancing interior and exterior projects alike.

## Suspended Liner Planters

Elevate your planting experience with our Suspended Liner Planters. Designed specifically for tall
containers, our innovative planters hold your grow pot securely at the top of the pot, eliminating
the need for fillers and platforms. Whether you choose to drop in a standard grow pot, replant
directly into the liner, or take advantage of our optional water indicator kit, our system offers
unmatched convenience and versatility. Perfect for interior plants, our Suspended Liner Planters
simplify the planting process, saving you time and effort while ensuring your plants look their
best.

## Furnish your world with intention, and Live Beautiful

“Living Beautiful” is a philosophy, a conscious choice to prioritize excellence in every facet of
life. It goes beyond mere aesthetics; it’s about the intrinsic value of things, their longevity, and
their ability to resonate with our sensibilities. TAU’s planters are a testament to this ethos.
Crafted with precision and care, each piece not only adds vibrancy to your spaces but also stands as
a beacon of unmatched craftsmanship. When you choose TAU, you’re not just selecting a planter,
you’re embracing a lifestyle that appreciates the finer nuances and quality that stands the test of
time.

## New Arrivals

Discover an invigorating collection of new designs and fresh finds, just what you need to spark your
creativity and revitalise your space. Say goodbye to the old and embrace the new with our energising
selection, guaranteed to provide you with the inspiration you’ve been looking for.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Is there someone I can talk to?

Yes, at [**Ten Thousand Pots**][71], we want you to have the best pot-purchasing experience
possible. As a result, there are no middlemen, and we interact with both resale and wholesale
customers daily. We are open **SEVEN DAYS A WEEK **from 9 AM to 6 PM. If you call during business
hours, M-F, an actual person will pick up the phone. Any of our staff would be happy to answer your
questions or smooth out concerns.

If you have any questions, contact us at [**(512) 584-8889**][72],
or [**austin@tenthousandpots.com**][73], and we will be happy to help.

Can I order online?

Yes, we offer our complete catalog in our online store with pickup, delivery and nationwide shipping
options. Our available website inventory is the same as our cataloged yard inventory, but we are
shipping, unloading, and updating our inventory daily. Occasionally there are minor discrepancies,
but what you see available on our website is what we have to sell you in-store.

Do you deliver?

Yes, we offer white-glove delivery throughout Central Texas. Our initial fee is $40 for the trip
charge and $3 per mile. Our team members will expertly unload, unpack, and place your larger pots
for you, and our specialists can install your custom fountains. In the case that a second person is
needed to load and unload your order safely, a $20 fee will be applied.

Freight shipping options are available for deliveries outside the state and for all online orders.

Do you ship?

Yes, we use a robust shipping network to pass the savings on to you. For orders up to 60 pounds, we
use UPS ground shipping. For orders 61 pounds or over, we use a network of freight carriers and pack
your order on pallets. We use top-of-the-line, custom-packaging products to ensure your order
arrives in perfect condition. Our breakage rate is less than 1%, so you can be confident that your
order will get to you safely and securely. However, if your ceramics arrived damaged in any way,
send a photo of the damage to austin@tenthousandpots.com, and we will refund or exchange the item.

For more information, see our [**Packing and Shipping**][74]** **page. If you're in need of a cargo
container of [wholesale flower pots and planters][75], please check out our sister company TT
Pottery.

Why does the pot I ordered look different in-person?

All our products are one-of-a-kind and handmade, meaning no two pieces are exactly alike. We've
selected an image that best represents each product type for our website inventory. When you
purchase this item, our team will hand-select your unique item from our inventory. There may be
slight variations in color, finish, glaze, size, etc. If you have a specific request or want a photo
of what we've pulled before shipment, our team will happily ensure your order exceeds expectations.
